purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, current public map configuration, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Municipio de Celaya evidence establishes a city-specific Dirección de Impuestos Inmobiliarios y Catastro. The municipal GIS currently exposes a CRS84 GeoJSON urban-block layer with 7,098 features and an extent containing the exact WUP point, but not a cadastral parcel layer. The official Predial portal loaded without exposing a safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-complete-polygon route.
registryAssessment: Local city cadastral custody found through the official Municipio de Celaya site. The official Predial portal is a municipal tax channel. Neither was treated as proof of citywide public parcel geometry availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official city page names Impuestos Inmobiliarios y Catastro and provides city catastro contacts.
Official municipal Predial portal loads as the city property-tax service; no public parcel geometry route was visible in the returned page.
Local Celaya municipal GIS page publishes planning/map layers and JavaScript configuration.

viewerConfiguration.observedVendor: OpenLayers client with static GeoJSON assets
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Successful GET returned GeoJSON FeatureCollection, 7,098 features, CRS `urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84`; feature properties included planning fields such as `No_manzana` and `Superficie`.
viewerConfiguration.exactPointExtentCheck: The returned urban-block dataset extent was approximately [-100.92679382005086, 20.366262038720034, -100.6620070662878, 20.68208515893839] in longitude/latitude order and contains the exact WUP point. This is an extent check only, not a parcel hit.
viewerConfiguration.nativeFieldNames: No cadastral parcel native fields observed; urban-block fields were not retained in a sample.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: HTTP 200; official city catastro page and local office/contact evidence returned.
HTTP 200; official municipal Predial landing page returned. No safe anonymous parcel geometry or stable parcel identity endpoint was identified in the page.
HTTP 200; current OpenLayers page and JavaScript configuration inspected. Published layers are municipal planning/map layers.
HTTP 200; bounded public GeoJSON response with 7,098 urban-block features and CRS84 metadata. Not cadastral parcel geometry; no feature retained.
HTTP 404 HTML response; no API schema or parcel response. This route was exploratory and did not include credentials or unsafe fields.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; the only successful geometry response was urban-block planning data, not a qualifying cadastral parcel response.

geometryEvidence.query: No parcel-point query submitted because no public cadastral parcel service and safe request shape were verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: City-specific catastro custody plus municipal planning GIS and Predial portal.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public urban-block GeoJSON only; no anonymous complete-polygon parcel feature verified.

remainingUncertainty: The map extent includes the WUP point, but map extent and urban-block presence do not prove a parcel hit. Any separate state/federal cadastral service, its parcel schema, native identity, CRS, access controls and citywide completeness remain unverified.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous safe ID-plus-parcel-geometry response; this packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
